summary: This is the API reference page for the rosbag::MessageInstance class from the ROS rosbag_storage package, generated from Doxygen. The class is a light-weight pointer into a bag file that holds a bag pointer and an index entry, and it is serializable under ros::message_traits. The page lists its public member functions (getTopic, getDataType, getMD5Sum, getTime, instantiate, isType, size, write and others), its private members and its friend class View.
one_line: Doxygen API reference for the ROS rosbag::MessageInstance C++ class, a light-weight pointer into a bag file.
key_facts: rosbag::MessageInstance is a class pointing into a bag file.
The MessageInstance class contains a pointer to a bag file and the index_entry needed to access the corresponding data.
MessageInstance adheres to the necessary ros::message_traits to be directly serializable.
The class is declared in message_instance.h, with implementation in message_instance.cpp.
The public member function getCallerId() returns std::string and is const.
The public member function getTopic() returns a std::string const reference and is const.
The public member function getDataType() returns a std::string const reference and is const.
The public member function getMD5Sum() returns a std::string const reference and is const.
The public member function getMessageDefinition() returns a std::string const reference and is const.
The public member function getTime() returns a ros::Time const reference and is const.
The templated instantiate() function returns a NULL pointer if the message type is incompatible.
The templated isType() function returns true if and only if the message is of the template type.
The size() function returns the size of the serialized message as uint32_t.
The private constructor takes a ConnectionInfo pointer, an IndexEntry reference and a Bag reference.
The class is a friend of class View, and the page was autogenerated on Thu Nov 23 2023 for rosbag_storage authored by Dirk Thomas and Jacob Perron.
